content.title: 5 top rare earth stock picks ahead of Trump and Xi meeting

The US and China are expected to reach a deal on Thursday when Presidents Trump and Xi are to meet in South Korea. Rare earth minerals are in focus with American rare earth stocks tumbling as US-China tensions ease. William Blair analyst Neal Dingmann shares his top stock picks in the sector.
